easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Vampire Charmseeker by paying its mana cost.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker and the Great Whale token.
When the Vampire Charmseeker and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
